title: What Canyon Got Wrong on the Endurace, and the Dream Bikes We Would Build Instead
content:
On this week’s Velo Podcast, Lisa’s review sparks a rant over proprietary mounts and flexy seatposts before the crew specs four competing dream rigs—and debates whether Zwift’s WattLock is cheating.

Read the full article at What Canyon Got Wrong on the Endurace, and the Dream Bikes We Would Build Instead on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
